{"id":1917292369,"question_id":4055,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1770920366,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"191 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1917292369/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Balanced Substring I","memory":"27 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    unordered_map<char,int>mp;\n    bool isValid(string &s , int i , int j)\n    {\n        if(mp.empty()) return true;\n        auto first_one = mp.begin();\n\n        for(auto &it : mp)\n        {\n            auto[ch , freq] = it;\n            if(freq != first_one->second) return false;\n        }\n    return true;\n    }\n\n    int longestBalanced(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        if(n == 1) return n;\n        int ans = INT_MIN;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-1 ; i++)\n        {\n            mp.clear();\n            mp[s[i]]++;\n\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                mp[s[j]]++;\n                if(isValid(s , i , j)) \n                {\n                    ans = max(ans , j-i+1);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return ans == INT_MIN ? 0 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-balanced-substring-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1690}
